newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Ship sinks after collision off S.Korea, 4 missing.
newsitem.headline: Ship sinks after collision off S.Korea, 4 missing.

text.p: Four of the eight crew members aboard a Belize-registered cargo vessel were missing after it collided with a Cyprian ship off South Korea and sank early on Tuesday, a maritime police officier said.
The police said the 1,189 gross ton Aldebaran sank after colliding with the 10,965 ton United Confidence in dense fog about 50 miles (80 km) off South Korea's port city of Mokpo.
He said the missing crew included one South Korean and three Filipinos. There were no casualties reported from the United Confidence.

"More than four ships along with a helicopter from the navy and maritime police were immediately sent to the site. But we cannot continue the search as it's getting dark," the police said by telephone.
"We fear all the missing crew members are already dead," he added.

The sunken ship, carrying 1,501 tonnes of ore, was headed for southern city of Kwangyang, while the United Confidence laden with 2,502 tonnes of steel sheets was on its way to southwestern port city of Inchon from Russia.
Police said there were serious oil slick from the sunken vessel.
